name: ablation_only_text_vision_loss
deviations: Paper hidden width, experts, top-k routing, objective weights, epochs and corpus are retained.
PPR alpha/epsilon, mixing schedule and per-epoch seed budget are reconstructed assumptions; an epoch exhausts all node seeds in every corpus graph.
Round-robin graph batches until each graph is exhausted. No cross-dataset negatives are introduced.
CLIP text and image provenance must pass independent checks before data is loaded.
Attention dropout can create zero embeddings; explicit gradient clipping to 1.0 is a documented engineering adaptation.
Windows Python 3.9.13 / torch 2.1.2 cu118 / DGL 1.1.2 differ from the paper's server stack.
A CLI max-steps override is only a resource/restore validation; it is not a complete epoch.
Ablation follows paper section 5.5; undisclosed implementation details are reconstructed. Only-loss variants keep the surviving main-profile weight.
